patterns.note: Neo-brutalist card layouts featuring thick black borders, high-contrast solid background colors, and pill-shaped containers.
Heavy, tightly-spaced sans-serif headings paired with clean, readable body text, often enclosed in pill-shaped badges or speech-bubble-like cards.
A vibrant, multi-colored palette featuring hot pink, bright orange, sky blue, and sunny yellow, grounded by stark black borders and white backgrounds.
A vertical scrolling countdown loader with numbered circles that counts down rapidly before transitioning and revealing the main page content.
Testimonials styled as overlapping, tilted cards with vibrant solid backgrounds, star ratings, and circular avatars.

technique_notes: To rebuild the loading sequence, use GSAP to animate a vertical stack of numbered circles scrolling rapidly upwards, fading out the loading screen once the countdown completes to reveal the main content.

Create the neo-brutalist aesthetic using thick, solid black borders on cards and buttons, combined with bright, saturated background colors and zero-offset box shadows to mimic a physical sticker or badge.
Implement a continuous horizontal marquee ticker in the footer using GSAP to smoothly translate a text track infinitely.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, ultra-bold grotesque headings with tight letter-spacing contrasted against clean, medium-weight body text.
design_tokens.radius: rounded (heavy use of pill shapes, fully rounded buttons, and moderately rounded card corners)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced (spacious hero and footer sections balanced by tightly packed, overlapping card grids)

standout: The site stands out through its playful neo-brutalist 'sticker-book' aesthetic, featuring tilted testimonial cards, hand-drawn style badges, and a unique vertical-scrolling countdown loader.
